page.layout: One printed page, no running text. Faint mirrored lines across the centre are show-through from the reverse side. A library stamp sits in the centre.
page.notes: The only legible printing is mirrored show-through from the reverse side (a title in large capitals with "PANEGYRICVS", "LVDOVICO HENRICO", "NASSOVIO", "ILLVSTRISSIMO, HEROI", "JOANNES MELCHIOR STEINBERG" and "LVGDVNI BATAVORVM" at the foot). These are not transcribed, as show-through is excluded. The blue "Staatsarchiv Koblenz" stamp is a library stamp and is excluded. No printed text of this side is legible enough to transcribe.
